name: Scenes
description: The Scenes plugin (id ilium.core.scenes, side: scene) is the plugin form of the animated scenes themselves.

wave_frequency.title: Wave frequency
wave_frequency.help: How many wave crests fit the screen height. More crests make narrower bands.

wave_amplitude.title: Wave warp
wave_amplitude.help: How strongly noise bends the bands. 0 gives plain parallel waves.

wave_speed.title: Wave speed
wave_speed.help: How fast the waves drift. 0 freezes the picture.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.help: The fixed dot lattice the waves are cut with. Coarser lattices show fewer gray steps.

levels.title: Gray levels
levels.help: Gray steps between empty and full ink. 2 draws pure dots.

pixel_size.title: Pixel size
pixel_size.help: Edge length of one dot block, in Braille dots.

intensity.title: Ink strength
intensity.help: How much ink the brightest dots carry before the shared look is applied.

band_sharpness.title: Band sharpness
band_sharpness.help: How abruptly the bands turn from empty to full.

bias.title: Dot bias
bias.help: Shifts the cut-off: positive adds dots, negative removes them.

ripple.title: Ripple
ripple.help: Adds a faint ripple around a slowly wandering point.

seed.title: Layout
seed.help: Picks one of many different wave layouts.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Selects the wave phases, the marquee bar pattern and where the dots blink.

gradient_speed.title: Gradient speed
gradient_speed.help: How fast the two dithered waves drift across the panel.

panel_size.title: Panel size
panel_size.help: Width and height of the screen as a share of the whole background.

cell_scale.title: Cell scale
cell_scale.help: Dots per dither cell. Larger cells give a coarser, more retro texture.

marquee_speed.title: Marquee speed
marquee_speed.help: Scroll speed of the bar band along the bottom. 0 holds it still.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.help: Dot intensity of the panel. The host dithers it further, so lower values give a sparser, quieter picture.

show_frame.title: Frame
show_frame.help: Draw a thin bezel around the panel.

blinking_dots.title: Blinking dots
blinking_dots.help: A few sparse dots inside the gradient switch on and off twice a second.

time_of_day.title: Time of day
time_of_day.help: Cycle animates the whole day. The other choices freeze the light at dawn, noon, dusk or night while clouds and waves keep moving.

day_length_seconds.title: Day length
day_length_seconds.help: Seconds for one full day: day, dusk, night and dawn. Only used while Time of day is Cycle.

cloud_coverage.title: Cloud coverage
cloud_coverage.help: How much of the sky is clouded. Clouds are brighter than the sky by day and darker at dusk.

cloud_speed.title: Cloud speed
cloud_speed.help: How fast the clouds drift sideways. 0 freezes them.

wave_speed.title: Wave speed
wave_speed.help: How fast the wave lines roll. 0 freezes the sea.

wave_scale.title: Wave spacing
wave_scale.help: Distance between wave lines. Small values give a choppier, busier sea.

star_density.title: Stars
star_density.help: How many stars appear at night, per thousand sky cells. 0 gives a starless night.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.help: Overall brightness of the picture. The default keeps it quiet enough for a background.

twinkle.title: Star twinkle
twinkle.help: Lets some single-dot stars blink out briefly, rarely and subtly.

banding.title: Banding
banding.help: Soft hands smooth gradients to the shared dither. The Bayer options step the gradients in the scene itself for a Playdate-like look.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Chooses the cloud pattern and star positions.

pipe_count.title: Pipes
pipe_count.help: How many pipes grow at the same time. A pipe that gets stuck restarts elsewhere.

volume_size.title: Grid size
volume_size.help: Cells per side of the cubic volume. Larger grids mean thinner-looking pipes and a longer build.

pipe_thickness.title: Thickness
pipe_thickness.help: Pipe diameter as a share of the grid spacing.

turn_chance.title: Turn chance
turn_chance.help: Chance that a pipe turns at each grid point. 0% makes straight runs until a wall or another pipe.

growth_speed.title: Growth speed
growth_speed.help: How many grid cells each pipe grows per second.

orbit_speed.title: Orbit speed
orbit_speed.help: How fast the camera circles the structure. 0% holds the camera still.

field_of_view.title: Field of view
field_of_view.help: Vertical viewing angle. Wide angles exaggerate perspective.

joint_style.title: Joints
joint_style.help: Ball spheres at every turn and end, rounded elbows, or bare mitered corners.

shading.title: Shading
shading.help: Soft lit gives smooth gradients, flat one tone per pipe, high contrast a bold halftone look.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.help: Optional rings or checker tiles on the pipe surface.

reset_mode.title: Reset
reset_mode.help: Start a new layout when the volume is full, or on a fixed period.

reset_seconds.title: Reset period
reset_seconds.help: Seconds between restarts, counted in animation time. Used with the Every N seconds reset.

seed_mode.title: Random seed
seed_mode.help: New each run picks different layouts every time; a fixed seed repeats the same sequence.

seed.title: Seed number
seed.help: The number that selects the sequence of layouts. Used with a fixed seed.

map.title: Map type
map.help: Which kind of expedition map to draw. All in turn reveals each type in the next, hex by hex.

map_seconds.title: Seconds per map
map_seconds.help: How long each map type stays on screen before the next one is revealed.

tile_size.title: Hex size
tile_size.help: Radius of one hex in Braille dots. Small hexes show more map; large ones show more sprite detail.

pan_speed.title: Pan speed
pan_speed.help: How fast the camera travels over the map, on top of the global Speed setting. 0% holds it still.

pan_style.title: Pan route
pan_style.help: A slowly curving expedition route, or a straight pan in one direction.

animation_speed.title: Tile animation
animation_speed.help: Speed of waves, swaying trees, smoke, lava and fires. 0% freezes the tiles.

stepped.title: Stepped tile frames
stepped.help: Plays tile animations as a few hand-drawn frames per second instead of smoothly. The camera stays smooth.

landmarks.title: Landmarks
landmarks.help: How many villages, camps, ruins, caves, mines and shrines are scattered over each island. Every island keeps its one ship and one goal while this is above 0%.

weather.title: Weather
weather.help: Adds falling snow, rising embers, blown sand or fireflies, depending on the map type.

cloud_shadows.title: Cloud shadows
cloud_shadows.help: Lets the shadows of drifting clouds pass over the map.

light.title: Tile light
light.help: Scales tile light before the shared look is applied.

tint.title: Biome colors
tint.help: Colours each tile by terrain. Off uses your global palette.

seed.title: Seed number
seed.help: Selects the world. The same seed always generates the same maps.

minimum_gap.title: Closest gap
minimum_gap.help: Minimum distance between tips, as a percentage of width.

reach.title: Arc reach
reach.help: How far the arc bodies curl away from their tips.

cycle_seconds.title: Approach cycle
cycle_seconds.help: Seconds for approach, lingering and retreat.

dwell.title: Near-contact linger
dwell.help: Higher values slow the tips near closest approach.

horizon_height.title: Ground height
horizon_height.help: Ink-free ground measured upward from the lower edge.

horizon_roughness.title: Horizon roughness
horizon_roughness.help: Seeded low hills; zero gives a level horizon.

curtain_count.title: Curtains
curtain_count.help: Overlapping bands with separate folds and crests.

curtain_motion.title: Curtain motion
curtain_motion.help: Slow folding; zero holds the same geometry at every time.

trees.title: Tree silhouettes
trees.help: Dark seeded trees rise just above the horizon without sky ink on them.

tree_density.title: Tree density
tree_density.help: Zero leaves the horizon clear, even when trees are enabled.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Repeatable skyline and tree placement.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.help: A new arrangement or geometric adaptations of two documented formations.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Changes the invented arrangement and small reference variations.

drawers.title: Visible drawers
drawers.help: Independent tips advance concurrently on different assigned strokes.

drawing_speed.title: Drawing speed
drawing_speed.help: Shortens or lengthens the shared drawing interval.

scale.title: Formation scale
scale.help: Fits circles to terminal aspect without stretching them.

delay_seconds.title: Reflection delay
delay_seconds.help: Seconds by which the lower ribbon follows the upper ribbon.

boundary.title: Waterline
boundary.help: Vertical position of the reflecting boundary, in percent.

distortion.title: Ripple distortion
distortion.help: Horizontal ripple amplitude of the reflected curve.

sway_seconds.title: Sway period
sway_seconds.help: Time for the original ribbon to sway once.

count.title: Firefly count
count.help: Bounded population of independent luminous dots.

drift.title: Drift
drift.help: Size of slow wandering paths; zero fixes positions.

synchronization.title: Synchronization
synchronization.help: Strength of the gradual gathering into a common rhythm and separation.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Selects positions and individual pulse rhythms.

marks.title: Rim marks
marks.help: Short orbiting dashes suggesting an invisible wheel.

visible_arc.title: Visible sector
visible_arc.help: Percentage of the rim where marks can appear.

dash_length.title: Dash length
dash_length.help: Percentage of each mark spacing occupied by ink.

horizon.title: Horizon
horizon.help: Sea horizon as a percentage from the top.

location.title: Lighthouse location
location.help: Horizontal position of the simple coastal silhouette.

beam_width.title: Beam width
beam_width.help: Angular spread of the sweeping light in degrees.

sweep.title: Sweep range
sweep.help: Maximum sweep above and below the horizon in degrees.

water_glints.title: Water glints
water_glints.help: Strength of short reflected marks; zero hides them.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Selects the repeatable water glint pattern.

threads.title: Thread count
threads.help: Number of curves constrained through the shared eye.

opening_x.title: Eye position
opening_x.help: Horizontal position of the shared opening, in percent.

spread.title: Fan spread
spread.help: Vertical extent of the loose threads.

sway_seconds.title: Sway period
sway_seconds.help: Seconds for one gentle thread sway.

depth.title: Fold depth
depth.help: Each additional fold doubles the path, up to 1024 segments.

cycle_seconds.title: Fold cycle
cycle_seconds.help: Seconds for unfolding, resting, refolding and resting.

scale.title: Path size
scale.help: Percentage of available space used by the trace.

count.title: Pollen count
count.help: Small seeded population; zero leaves only the sunbeam.

beam_width.title: Beam width
beam_width.help: Width of the shaft as a percentage of the field.

beam_motion.title: Beam motion
beam_motion.help: Slow sideways sway; zero holds the beam still.

drift.title: Drift
drift.help: Speed of drifting pollen; zero freezes particle positions.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Selects repeatable pollen positions.

grid_size.title: Spiral width
grid_size.help: Odd grid width; at most 4225 cached number positions.

sweep_seconds.title: Sweep period
sweep_seconds.help: Time for diagonal illumination to cross the number spiral.

background.title: Faint dots
background.help: Brightness of nonprime points, in percent.

rings.title: Ring count
rings.help: Concentric rings with independent drifting gaps.

gap_degrees.title: Gap width
gap_degrees.help: Angular width of each missing arc.

wobble.title: Imperfection
wobble.help: Small radial ripples as a percentage of ring spacing.

turn_seconds.title: Gap orbit
turn_seconds.help: Seconds for the missing sections to orbit.

columns.title: Repeat columns
columns.help: Number of repeating motifs across the viewport.

rotation_seconds.title: Rotation period
rotation_seconds.help: Time for each tile motif to rotate once.

symmetry.title: Symmetry
symmetry.help: Repeat identically, alternate mirror or alternate quarter turns.

window_count.title: Windows
window_count.help: Independent projections arranged across the field.

size.title: Window size
size.help: Projection width within each window slot.

gap.title: Pane gap
gap.help: Dark separation between panes; pollen never lights in these gaps.

location_x.title: Horizontal location
location_x.help: Moves the entire group of projections sideways.

shear.title: Projection slant
shear.help: Horizontal skew from the top to bottom of each projection.

motion.title: Sun motion
motion.help: Slow movement and stretching of the projections.

pollen_count.title: Pollen count
pollen_count.help: Small seeded population revealed only inside illuminated panes.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Selects pollen paths and subtle pane texture.

grid.title: Pane grid
grid.help: Two columns with two or three rows of separate light panes.

pollen.title: Pollen
pollen.help: Reveal drifting pollen only within lit panes, preserving dark mullions.

hour_format.title: Hour format
hour_format.help: 24 hours shows 07:05. 12 hours drops the leading zero and marks PM with two small dots above the last digit (AM has one).

show_seconds.title: Show seconds
show_seconds.help: Append the seconds to the digital readout. The minute ring shows them either way.

clock_position.title: Readout
clock_position.help: Where the small digital time is drawn. Hidden leaves only the cube and the minute ring.

cube_size.title: Cube size
cube_size.help: Size of the cube relative to the smaller side of the pane. Large cubes can touch the readout.

rotation_rate.title: Rotation speed
rotation_rate.help: How fast the cube turns. 100% is one full turn about every 18 seconds; 0% freezes it.

second_tick.title: Second tick
second_tick.help: Give the cube a small eased nudge at every real second, like a clock movement.

minute_ring.title: Minute ring
minute_ring.help: A ring of 60 faint dots behind the cube. The current second glows and leaves a short trail.

face_shading.title: Face shading
face_shading.help: Sparse dither on the faces turned towards you. 0% is a pure wireframe.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.help: Scales every dot of this scene. The defaults are deliberately dim for use behind text.

dust.title: Dust
dust.help: A few faint twinkling dots in the background.

time_zone_from_location.title: Zone from location
time_zone_from_location.help: Estimate the time zone from the longitude of your location (15 degrees per hour, no daylight saving). Turn off to set the offset by hand.

utc_offset_hours.title: UTC offset
utc_offset_hours.help: Hours added to UTC. Only used when Zone from location is off.

mode.title: Pi rendering
mode.help: Native text uses the terminal font. Font Braille rasterizes the bundled Cascadia Code.

font_size.title: Font size
font_size.help: Real-font height in Braille raster dots. Native text uses the terminal emulator's configured size.

digits_limit.title: Exact digits
digits_limit.help: Number of exact decimal digits, including the initial 3. The decimal separator is added for display; the sequence repeats after this prefix.

scroll_speed.title: Scroll speed
scroll_speed.help: Move through the exact digit sequence. Zero holds the prefix; global Speed also applies.

colour_angle.title: Pi colour angle
colour_angle.help: Common colour of decimal digits when digit colours are disabled.

ink_level.title: Pi ink level
ink_level.help: Zero hides both native and Braille text. Colour strength and dot coverage are independent.

digit_colors.title: Colors by digit
digit_colors.help: Assign a separate colour angle to each decimal digit. The decimal separator keeps the common colour.

digit_0_angle.title: Digit 0 colour angle
digit_0_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_1_angle.title: Digit 1 colour angle
digit_1_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_2_angle.title: Digit 2 colour angle
digit_2_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_3_angle.title: Digit 3 colour angle
digit_3_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_4_angle.title: Digit 4 colour angle
digit_4_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_5_angle.title: Digit 5 colour angle
digit_5_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_6_angle.title: Digit 6 colour angle
digit_6_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_7_angle.title: Digit 7 colour angle
digit_7_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_8_angle.title: Digit 8 colour angle
digit_8_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

digit_9_angle.title: Digit 9 colour angle
digit_9_angle.help: Colour angle assigned to this exact decimal digit; used when Colors by digit is on.

wave_scale.title: Wave size
wave_scale.help: Spatial frequency of the waves. Higher values give smaller, busier ripples.

flow_speed.title: Flow speed
flow_speed.help: How fast the light bands drift and shimmer, on top of the global Speed setting.

sharpness.title: Sharpness
sharpness.help: Higher values narrow the bright caustic lines and leave more dark water between them.

density.title: Density
density.help: Shifts the black and white balance. Positive values switch more dots on.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.help: Below the default, lit dots thin out. Above it, the blue tint gets brighter. The default keeps the water a quiet background.

perspective.title: Perspective
perspective.help: Squeezes the waves toward a horizon and fades the far water. 0% is a flat top-down surface.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.help: Size of the fixed threshold matrix. Coarser matrices look chunkier.

ripples.title: Ripples
ripples.help: Draws slowly expanding elliptical rings on top of the waves.

stepped.title: Stepped motion
stepped.help: Advances the water in eight steps per second for a hand-animated pixel-art stutter.

tint.title: Blue tint
tint.help: Colours lit dots from deep blue to pale cyan. Off uses your global palette.

seed.title: Seed number
seed.help: Selects the wave phases and where ripples appear.

seed.title: Machine
seed.help: The number that selects the machine layout. Every number builds a different machine.

tile_size.title: Tile size
tile_size.help: Edge of one machine tile. Smaller tiles make a denser machine with more loops.

density.title: Rail density
density.help: How much of the floor carries rails. Low values leave large empty areas.

screens.title: Screens
screens.help: Most little screens (dithered gradient and scrolling marquee) the machine may hold. 0 removes them.

speed.title: Box speed
speed.help: How fast boxes slide along the rails. Multiplied by the global Speed setting.

spacing.title: Box spacing
spacing.help: Distance between boxes on one loop. Smaller values put more boxes on the rails.

rail_level.title: Rail ink
rail_level.help: Ink level of the rails. 0% hides them so the boxes seem to float.

cube_level.title: Box ink
cube_level.help: Ink level of the box outlines. Their centers are drawn at half of it.

rails_dashed.title: Dotted rails
rails_dashed.help: Draw rails as a dotted track instead of a solid line.

reverse_alt.title: Alternate directions
reverse_alt.help: Loops take turns running clockwise and counterclockwise. Off sends every box the same way round.

scale.title: Cloud scale
scale.help: Larger values pack in smaller, busier clouds; smaller values give a few huge banks.

drift.title: Fold speed
drift.help: How fast the cloud folds slowly morph into each other. 0% freezes the folding.

pan.title: Pan
pan.help: Sideways drift of the whole sky. Negative values move it the other way, 0 holds it still.

warp.title: Warp
warp.help: How much clouds displace themselves. 0% gives plain fractal noise, 100% the swirling look.

octaves.title: Detail
octaves.help: Noise octaves. Fewer octaves are smoother and cheaper, more add fine wisps.

tone_steepness.title: Tone steepness
tone_steepness.help: Steepness of the dither response: lower is a softer, grainier sky.

block.title: Pixel size
block.help: Size of the chunky blocks the clouds are sampled at. Larger blocks are coarser and cheaper.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.help: Pattern of the one-bit threshold: regular crosshatch, even grain or rough stipple.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.help: Intensity of lit dots. Keep it low for a quiet background.

invert.title: Invert
invert.help: Swap lit and dark: dark clouds on a dotted field.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Selects the cloud layout.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.help: The animated field that is turned into dots. Every pattern loops seamlessly.

grain.title: Grain
grain.help: Ordered is a regular screen, Floyd-Steinberg organic grain, random noise a slow twinkle, threshold flat shapes.

density.title: Density
density.help: Brightness bias. 50 is neutral; higher fills more dots, lower leaves only the brightest parts.

complexity.title: Complexity
complexity.help: Noise octaves, spiral arms, tunnel segments, star count or drop count, depending on the pattern.

scale.title: Scale
scale.help: Spatial frequency of the pattern. Higher means finer detail.

grain_amount.title: Grain amount
grain_amount.help: 0% cuts the field at one level (banded); 100% applies the full grain texture.

loop_seconds.title: Loop length
loop_seconds.help: Animation time after which the pattern repeats exactly. Shorter loops move faster.

dot_level.title: Dot level
dot_level.help: Brightest dot intensity. Keep it low for quiet background art.

matrix.title: Bayer matrix
matrix.help: Matrix size of the ordered grain; 4 x 4 is coarser, 8 x 8 smoother.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Selects the noise layout, star positions and drop centres.

invert.title: Invert
invert.help: Draw dots on the dark parts of the pattern instead of the bright parts.

simulation_speed.title: Simulation speed
simulation_speed.help: Rate of economy, diplomacy and fleet ticks. Global Speed also applies; changing this keeps the current galaxy.

camera_speed.title: Camera speed
camera_speed.help: Clockwise orbit multiplier; 0% holds the camera while empires keep moving.

orbit_period_seconds.title: Orbit period
orbit_period_seconds.help: Seconds for one orbit at Camera speed 100% and Global Speed 1. Default: 900 s.

camera_zoom.title: Camera zoom
camera_zoom.help: 100% shows one quarter of the disk's area. Higher zoom shows a smaller field without changing the galaxy.

star_count.title: Star systems
star_count.help: Size of the connected galaxy. Default: 480, 50% more than the previous 320. Changing this starts a new galaxy.

empire_count.title: Starting empires
empire_count.help: Separately founded civilizations; changing this starts a new galaxy.

seed.title: Galaxy seed
seed.help: 0 chooses a fresh galaxy. A positive seed reproduces its initial map and simulation; changing it restarts.

spiral_arms.title: Spiral arms
spiral_arms.help: Number of arms in the generated map. Changing the shape starts a new galaxy.

arm_spread.title: Arm spread
arm_spread.help: Angular scatter around each arm; 100% retains the original shape.

arm_twist.title: Arm twist
arm_twist.help: How much arms turn from center to rim; 100% retains the original twist.

lane_links.title: Extra hyperlane links
lane_links.help: Up to this many short extra links per star. Zero still keeps a connected backbone.

territory_strength.title: Territory shading
territory_strength.help: Overall territory ink. Zero hides fills, borders and contact but leaves stars and lanes.

territory_radius.title: Territory size
territory_radius.help: Influence radius around each star; adjusting it rebuilds only the territory field.

territory_softness.title: Territory softness
territory_softness.help: Width of each soft edge. 100% retains the original rounded border.

territory_border.title: Border emphasis
territory_border.help: Strength of the territory contour. Zero removes the contour, not the fill.

territory_contact.title: Contact emphasis
territory_contact.help: Brightness where opposing territories meet; wars pulse slightly.

star_size.title: Star size
star_size.help: Radius of system markers; 100% retains the original size.

star_glow.title: Star glow
star_glow.help: System marker intensity. Zero hides markers without erasing territory or lanes.

show_lanes.title: Show hyperlanes
show_lanes.help: Draw the connection graph between systems. Hiding it does not disconnect the simulation.

lane_glow.title: Hyperlane glow
lane_glow.help: Visible lane intensity. Zero hides lane ink without changing fleet routes.

show_fleets.title: Show fleets
show_fleets.help: Moving markers on hyperlanes; turning them off keeps the simulation running.

fleet_size.title: Fleet size
fleet_size.help: Size of fleet heads and trails.

fleet_glow.title: Fleet glow
fleet_glow.help: Fleet marker intensity. Zero hides fleet ink without changing the simulation.

fleet_trail_length.title: Fleet trails
fleet_trail_length.help: Trail length behind moving fleet heads. Zero disables trails; 100% retains the original length.

capture_flashes.title: Capture flashes
capture_flashes.help: Make freshly captured system markers briefly larger.

victory_hold_seconds.title: Victory pause
victory_hold_seconds.help: Simulation seconds to show the winner before the next galaxy; Simulation speed and Global Speed scale wall time.

distance_realism.title: Distance realism
distance_realism.help: 0% compresses orbital distances logarithmically; 100% preserves physical distance ratios. Inner planets become clustered near the Sun at realistic scale.

size_realism.title: Size realism
size_realism.help: 0% exaggerates body sizes; 100% uses physical radii at the orbital scale. Sub-dot bodies retain a one-dot marker so they remain visible.

time_speed.title: Simulation speed
time_speed.help: Simulated time per animation second. Orbits follow approximate JPL elements, beginning at J2000; global animation speed also applies.

orbit_paths.title: Orbit paths
orbit_paths.help: Draw each visible planet's orbital path, including eccentricity and inclination, viewed from above the ecliptic.

mercury.title: Mercury
mercury.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

venus.title: Venus
venus.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

earth.title: Earth
earth.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

mars.title: Mars
mars.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

jupiter.title: Jupiter
jupiter.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

saturn.title: Saturn
saturn.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

uranus.title: Uranus
uranus.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

neptune.title: Neptune
neptune.help: Show this planet and its orbital path. Hidden planets do not change the scale of the remaining solar system.

dot_count.title: Dots
dot_count.help: How many dots the wind carries. They live only in empty screen cells.

dot_weight.title: Dot weight
dot_weight.help: Average weight. Light dots follow the wind and pushes closely; heavy dots resist both and fall faster under gravity.

weight_variation.title: Weight variation
weight_variation.help: How much the weights of single dots differ. 0% makes all dots identical.

drag.title: Air drag
drag.help: Resistance of the air. High drag stops dots quickly and lowers their top speed.

wind_strength.title: Wind strength
wind_strength.help: Force of the wind. 0% leaves only gravity and pushes.

wind_angle.title: Wind direction
wind_angle.help: Where the wind blows to: 0° right, 90° down, 180° left, 270° up. With a rotating wind this is the start direction.

wind_mode.title: Wind mode
wind_mode.help: Fixed keeps one direction; Rotating turns the wind steadily around.

rotation_speed.title: Rotation speed
rotation_speed.help: Degrees per second the wind turns. Positive turns clockwise on screen, negative counter-clockwise.

gusts.title: Gusts
gusts.help: How much the wind strength and direction vary from place to place and over time.

gravity_enabled.title: Gravity
gravity_enabled.help: Pull every dot toward the bottom of the screen. Heavy dots fall faster than light ones.

bounce.title: Bounce
bounce.help: Speed a dot keeps when it hits text or a wall. 0% makes dots stick and slide.

edge_mode.title: Screen edges
edge_mode.help: Dots wrap to the opposite side, or bounce off the screen edge.

scroll_push.title: Scroll push
scroll_push.help: Speed given to dots by text that scrolls into their cell, in the direction it moves. 0% ignores scrolling.

appear_push.title: Appear push
appear_push.help: Speed given to dots by text that appears from nowhere, such as typing. Usually gentler than scrolling.

push_reach.title: Push reach
push_reach.help: How many cells away from changing text a dot is still pushed. 0 pushes only dots the text lands on.

scroll_range.title: Scroll detection
scroll_range.help: Largest jump in cells that still counts as scrolling. Larger values follow fast scrolling but may misread new text.

diffusion.title: Diffusion
diffusion.help: Nearby dots push each other apart, which keeps them from bunching up. 0% lets dots pile together freely.

dispersion.title: Dispersion
dispersion.help: Every so often a random dot jumps to a random empty place on the screen. Higher values do it more often. 0% never does.

mouse_force.title: Mouse force
mouse_force.help: The mouse pushes nearby dots away. Move the pointer to move particles; turn off to ignore it.

merge_dots.title: Merge dots
merge_dots.help: Dots piled into one cell become a larger dot character; twice as many become a larger one still.

merge_threshold.title: Merge at
merge_threshold.help: How many dots in one cell make the larger dot.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.help: Selects the starting positions and weights of the dots.

frame_rate.title: Frame rate
frame_rate.help: Redraws per second. Higher is smoother and uses more processor time.

carpet_mode.title: Simulation
carpet_mode.help: Choose one of nine hidden-object simulations.

carpet_yaw.title: Camera yaw
carpet_yaw.help: Rotate the ground plane without rotating hidden model coordinates.

carpet_pitch.title: Camera pitch
carpet_pitch.help: Ground elevation angle; 30 degrees gives an isometric view.

carpet_hatch_direction.title: Hatch direction
carpet_hatch_direction.help: All lines share this direction in the ground plane.

carpet_infinite_lines.title: Infinite lines
carpet_infinite_lines.help: Continue flat hatch lines to the viewport edges beyond the ground.

carpet_spacing.title: Hatch spacing
carpet_spacing.help: Distance between parallel hatch lines measured in Braille dots.

carpet_line_width.title: Line width
carpet_line_width.help: Thickness of one hatch line relative to one Braille dot.

carpet_radius.title: Object radius
carpet_radius.help: Radius in thousandths of the normalized ground width.

carpet_softness.title: Bend softness
carpet_softness.help: Shape the rounded lift around spheres and tubes without changing their support radius.

carpet_easing_ms.title: Motion easing
carpet_easing_ms.help: Smooth transition duration; limited to one game step, generation or clock tick so each change can settle.

carpet_fps.title: Frame rate
carpet_fps.help: Maximum Carpet redraw cadence; lower values reduce rendering work.

carpet_simulation_speed.title: Simulation speed
carpet_simulation_speed.help: Scale games and motion; civil clocks always display live time.

carpet_seed.title: Seed
carpet_seed.help: Reproducible simulation seed. A change starts a new simulation.

carpet_snake_initial_length.title: Initial length
carpet_snake_initial_length.help: Snake length at the beginning of each game.

carpet_life_generation_ms.title: Life generation
carpet_life_generation_ms.help: Slow default generation interval; easing interpolates births and deaths.

carpet_orbit_speed.title: Orbit speed
carpet_orbit_speed.help: Stylized planetary motion rate; not an astronomical ephemeris.

carpet_orbit_scale.title: Orbit scale
carpet_orbit_scale.help: Scale the planetary system within the ground.

carpet_utc_offset_minutes.title: UTC offset
carpet_utc_offset_minutes.help: Civil clock offset from UTC; default explicitly displays UTC.

carpet_chess_ai_depth.title: AI depth
carpet_chess_ai_depth.help: Bounded lookahead for automated legal chess moves.

carpet_chess_node_budget.title: AI budget
carpet_chess_node_budget.help: Hard search-work ceiling for every autonomous move.

carpet_chess_restart_ms.title: New game delay
carpet_chess_restart_ms.help: Hold finished games before starting another.

carpet_chess_max_plies.title: Game move limit
carpet_chess_max_plies.help: Maximum game length before a new seeded game begins.

carpet_chess_easing_ms.title: Piece easing
carpet_chess_easing_ms.help: Duration of eased chess movements and capture fades.

carpet_pawn_height.title: Pawn height
carpet_pawn_height.help: Lift for pawn pieces relative to base height.

carpet_knight_height.title: Knight height
carpet_knight_height.help: Lift for knight pieces relative to base height.

carpet_bishop_height.title: Bishop height
carpet_bishop_height.help: Lift for bishop pieces relative to base height.

carpet_rook_height.title: Rook height
carpet_rook_height.help: Lift for rook pieces relative to base height.

carpet_queen_height.title: Queen height
carpet_queen_height.help: Lift for queen pieces relative to base height.

carpet_king_height.title: King height
carpet_king_height.help: Lift for king pieces relative to base height.

carpet_clock_seconds.title: Clock seconds
carpet_clock_seconds.help: Include seconds in both civil clocks.

carpet_clock_tubes.title: Clock hands
carpet_clock_tubes.help: Draw analog hands as hidden tubes between the center and live points.

black_at_bottom.title: Black at bottom
black_at_bottom.help: Rotate the board by 180 degrees. Pieces remain upright.

brightness_percent.title: Chess brightness
brightness_percent.help: Intensity before Braille dithering; zero hides the board and pieces.

white_red.title: White red
white_red.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

white_green.title: White green
white_green.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

white_blue.title: White blue
white_blue.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

black_red.title: Black red
black_red.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

black_green.title: Black green
black_green.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

black_blue.title: Black blue
black_blue.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

board_red.title: Board red
board_red.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

board_green.title: Board green
board_green.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

board_blue.title: Board blue
board_blue.help: Independent RGB channel; changing color preserves dot density.

mode.title: Growth source
mode.help: Start at the outer frame or beside visible text, without reading its content.

reach.title: Reach
reach.help: Maximum distance a crystalline branch travels from its source.

branching.title: Branching
branching.help: Small side twigs along each cached main branch.

growth_seconds.title: Growth time
growth_seconds.help: Grow, hold briefly, retreat, then begin again.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Repeatable branch placement and crystalline bends.

petals.title: Rose parameter
petals.help: Integer frequency of the Maurer rose.

stitches.title: Stitch count
stitches.help: Maximum cached chords in the embroidery.

cycle_seconds.title: Drawing cycle
cycle_seconds.help: Seconds for drawing, resting and fading.

loops.title: Curl count
loops.help: Number of curls in the bounded wandering stroke.

cycle_seconds.title: Drawing cycle
cycle_seconds.help: Time for drawing, hesitating, resting and fading.

hesitation.title: Pause strength
hesitation.help: Time held still within each curl. Zero draws continuously.

seed.title: Path seed
seed.help: Stable seed changes the curl phases and amplitudes.

color_mode.title: Color mode
color_mode.help: Use one tone or palette-derived cell colors

density.title: Density
density.help: How much of the field the colony fills before it thins out.

branch_angle.title: Branch variation
branch_angle.help: How far each branch may bend away from its parent.

seeds.title: Initial seeds
seeds.help: Number of points the colony grows from at the start and after each reseed.

reserve_edge.title: Reserve edge
reserve_edge.help: Keep an outside rim as a permanent source

reserve_width.title: Reserve width
reserve_width.help: Width of the permanent outside rim, in cells.

mouse_radius.title: Mouse radius
mouse_radius.help: How far around the pointer the colony is cleared, in cells.

appear_erase.title: Appear erase
appear_erase.help: How much of the colony is cleared where new text appears.

scroll_erase.title: Scroll erase
scroll_erase.help: How much of the colony is cleared when the screen scrolls.

scroll_push.title: Scroll push
scroll_push.help: How much of the colony is pushed along when the screen scrolls.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.help: Selects repeatable seed positions.

map.title: Map
map.help: Play every map in turn, moving on after each cleared level, or stay on one map. Changing it restarts the game.

start_level.title: Start level
start_level.help: Later levels start with more money, stronger monsters and more tower types unlocked. Changing it restarts the game.

waves.title: Waves per level
waves.help: Waves to survive before a level is cleared; every tenth wave brings a boss.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.help: Monster health. On Hard the AI sometimes loses a level and retries it with stronger towers.

game_speed.title: Game speed
game_speed.help: How fast the game plays, on top of the global Speed setting.

palette.title: Colours
palette.help: Black and white uses only the global palette; Colour gives every tower, monster and shot its own colour.

scheme.title: Colour scheme
scheme.help: The base colours. The sliders below adjust them further.

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.help: How bright the lines and fills are. Lower values thin the dots out.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.help: Spreads the difference between dim and bright parts, such as grid against towers.

hue.title: Hue
hue.help: Rotates every colour around the colour wheel.

saturation.title: Saturation
saturation.help: 0 is grey, 100 the scheme as designed, 200 as vivid as possible.

glow.title: Glow
glow.help: How strongly towers, monsters and the path are filled rather than only outlined.

grid.title: Grid
grid.help: Draw the faint cell grid of the board.

range_rings.title: Range rings
range_rings.help: Always show the firing range of every tower, not only when it is built or upgraded.

hud.title: Status line
hud.help: Show level, wave, money and lives along the top.

seed.title: Seed
seed.help: Seeds the random details of the game. Changing it restarts the game.
